  4. {{ _("I state that the amount paid to me is my annual leave pay in advance, under Article (109) of the Labor Law, and is in no case a compensation in lieu of the leave or a waiver of it.", context="Vacation Allowance Undertaking") }}
  5. {{ _("I undertake not to work in any form during the leave (full time, part time or additional assignments), and I understand that any work during the leave requires prior written approval of the company management only, without any additional financial obligation unless agreed in writing.", context="Vacation Allowance Undertaking") }}
